author: Fre-con123

title: Great experience
text:
We had an amazing tour around the outside of the Sagrada Familia! Núria was absolutely wonderful - so nice, energetic, and very knowledgeable. She shared so many interesting facts and insights about the Sagrada Familia that we never would have noticed on our own, making the entire experience incredibly fun and engaging.

She also went above and beyond by warning us to be careful of pickpockets in the busy area, which we deeply appreciated as travelers. If you want a fun, informative, and safe introduction to this iconic landmark, definitely book this tour!
